verdict.rationale: Google Cloud publishes an official pricing calculator where you add and configure products to get a shareable cost estimate before committing. Its free-program page publicly states the $300 credit and the per-product free usage limits, and notes you are not charged until you activate a paid account. Missing for 10: direct evidence of per-service public pricing pages (rates beyond free-tier limits), independent or hands-on corroboration of the calculator's accuracy for estimating a full stack.
